newsitem.title: USA: Commonwealth Energy Q1 shr $1.21 vs $1.28.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth Energy Q1 shr $1.21 vs $1.28.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

Note: The 5.5 percent decline in Q1 EPS reflects the absence of the 1996 reversal of a reserve for Canal Electric Co's postretirement benefits costs that were subsequently recovered in wholesale rates and the 5.2 percent decline in firm gas unit sales consistent with milder weather in the 1997 quarter.
Note: Heating degree days for the quarter were 10.8 percent lower for 1997 compared to 1996 and 7.1 percent below normal.
Note: Partially offsetting these factors were lower interest costs.
